Show ragged crumb and a matte pale-yellow cultured-butter smear, never strands. Keep salt sparse and irregular. Upper-left sunlight anchors one firm shadow beneath the peel. Retain the worn architectural gilt edge; restrict burnt ochre to the handle. Remove every figure. Neoclassical oil painting in the manner of Jacques-Louis David and Ingres: smooth glazed brushwork, warm ochre and umber flesh tones, deep ultramarine sky, gilded details, dramatic chiaroscuro from the upper left, faint canvas texture and craquelure. One accent pigment close to #b45309 used sparingly on drapery or a single object. Figures, if any, are painted, never photographic; shown at medium distance with faces turned three-quarter or away and hands simplified. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no frame or border. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
brief.negative: No figures, laps, hands, statues, extra rolls, plates, cloth, utensils, or packaging. No oversized bread, silhouette tangencies, detached bread halves, stringy butter, dripping butter, translucent glue-like crumb, glossy crust, duplicated salt, floating peel, or photographic rendering. No additional lighting, crowded upper-left third, text, letters, signs, logos, watermarks, frame, or border.

tells: plastic/over-glossy highlights on crust
photo-render bread against painted backdrop
peel projects off ledge at an impossible angle
statue is stiffly centred behind bread
gilded frame-like ledge confuses whether we see a painting or a table
claude.fix: Kill the specular glaze on the crust, lay the peel flat on the marble with its handle inside frame, and shift the statue further right out of the bread's silhouette.

tells: plastic/over-glossy highlights: the crust and exposed butter have conspicuously slick, polished highlights
generic stock composition: the front-facing split and showcased filling feel mechanically arranged for advertising
style drift from the requested world: the foreground reads as commercial food photography rather than part of the neoclassical painting
astra.fix: Show an unevenly torn roll in three-quarter view, using restrained painted highlights rather than a glossy frontal filling reveal.

tells: red drape attaches to the column impossibly (melted detail)
bread is photoreal while everything else is painted
peel floats without contact shadow
oversaturated sky
statue placed just above bread creating awkward stacking
claude.fix: Remove the floating red drape, paint the roll in matte oil-paint handling with a single warm cast shadow on the peel, and drop the statue lower behind the balustrade.

tells: plastic/over-glossy highlights: the roll's bright, continuous sheen looks varnished
generic stock composition: the carefully opened roll, scattered flour, and diagonal board form a familiar bakery-stock setup
style drift from the requested world: photographic bread contrasts with theatrical painted drapery and architecture
oversaturation: the strong orange-red drapery, blue sky, and bright gold ornament compete with the bread
astra.fix: Repaint the scene in a restrained earth-pigment palette with matte bread highlights and substantially quieter red drapery.
